title: 2007 GTI

source.name: Volkswagen maintenance schedule
source.note: From Volkswagen's July 2022 reissue of its 2007 USA maintenance schedule, in Glovebox's wording; no card from the time was found. Check it against the booklet that came with your own car.
source.basis: The mileages and jobs of Volkswagen's own USA maintenance schedule for the model year, as Volkswagen publishes it for owners, for a car the owner maintains. Only those facts are taken; jobs are named in Glovebox's words and no text or layout is copied.

Check automatic transmission for leaks (automatic only)
manualOnly: Check manual gearbox oil level and for leaks (manual only)
